nodes.question: How could stringent eco-design requirements benefit FTI brands in reducing their environmental impact?
nodes.answer: Stringent eco-design requirements could help FTI brands account for and reduce their environmental impact earlier in the life cycle by focusing on sustainable practices from the start.
